paper.citation: Deng, S., Ning, Y., Zhao, J. and Zhang, H. (2024). Optimal and Safe Estimation for High-Dimensional Semi-Supervised Learning. Journal of the American Statistical Association 119(548), 2748-2759. DOI: 10.1080/01621459.2023.2277409.
paper.title: Optimal and Safe Estimation for High-Dimensional Semi-Supervised Learning
paper.venue: Journal of the American Statistical Association
paper.source_version: Pinned arXiv:2011.14185v2, 2023-03-18, 57 pages. The journal publication identity is verified against the publisher and PMC metadata; contribution IDs use the verified journal year only, without inferring a publication month. Final typeset simulation equations were not independently compared; fidelity is to the pinned preprint with the explicit adaptations below.
paper.source_locator: Pinned arXiv v2 Section 6.1, Model 2, printed/PDF p.16; p=500,nL=200 in Section 6.2 pp.17-19 and Figures 1-3 pp.18-20, select N/n=5. Page numbers refer to arXiv v2, not the journal.

mechanism.name: Folded-AR Gaussian Quadratic Interaction and Cubic Projection

generation_equations.label: Covariates
generation_equations.expression: Z~N_500(0,Sigma), Sigma_jk=0.3^|j-k|; X1=abs(Z1), Xj=Zj for j>1. Exact stationary AR recursion generates Z.

generation_equations.label: Response
generation_equations.expression: Y = 0.6 (X1+X2)^2 + 0.4 X4^3 - X5 + 2 X6 + epsilon; epsilon~N(0,1) independent of Z and all other units.

generation_equations.label: Sampling
generation_equations.expression: Independent iid labeled and unlabeled samples from the same complete-data population; nL=200,nU=1000 reference. Export X1..X500,R,Y_obs.

latent_variables.name: Z1
latent_variables.role: Gaussian sign before folding, never exported

sampling.dependence: Independent complete-data units; fixed labeled/unlabeled group indicators, not independent Bernoulli indicators. Coordinate dependence is specified in equations.
sampling.n_semantics: n is combined table row count
sampling.predictor_source: No external or oracle predictor supplied. Downstream nuisance regressors must be trained on labeled training folds only; cross-fitting and tuning belong to the later estimator benchmark. No prediction is substituted for Y_obs.

assumptions: Independent units and independent standard Gaussian outcome noise.
Labeled and unlabeled groups share one population; fixed group counts independent of data.
Positive definite covariance of centered X and finite response second moment.
R masks Y_obs; unlabeled zero values are placeholders.

properties.notes: 500 input coordinates and 200 reference labels. Raw first covariate folded normal, other coordinates correlated Gaussian. Model 2; quadratic X1-X2 interaction and cubic X4 term.

estimand.name: beta_4
estimand.definition: Coordinate 4 of beta in argmin_(alpha,beta) E[(Y-alpha-X^T beta)^2]. All 500 observed covariates are included, with an intercept.

truth.expression: Coordinate 4 of beta in argmin_(alpha,beta) E[(Y-alpha-X^T beta)^2]. All 500 observed covariates are included, with an intercept.
truth.derivation: Gaussian integration by parts; covariance-aware scalar projection slope

adaptations: Map independent labeled/unlabeled samples to one table with n=total rows. nL=max(1,min(n-1,floor(n*200/1200))); nU=n-nL. At n=1200 the source sample counts (200,1000) are exact. R=0 implies Y_obs=0 placeholder, not observed zero.

Export raw X1=abs(Z1) and raw Y from the printed response formula. Define the target as one slope in the population linear projection WITH intercept. These slopes equal those from population-centering X and Y as in the paper; do not fit a no-intercept regression to the exported raw table.
Select one scalar coordinate of the original vector regression target, not a different DGP. No fitted prediction, oracle response or hidden noise is exported.

Independent PCG64 implementation. All coefficients are fixed across rows and replications; p=500,nL=200,N/n=5 selected from source experiments. No original estimation algorithm or benchmark is reproduced.
